items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And there was one band that had a woman that played so good, Andy Kirk.

ctx.x: And there was one band that had a woman that played so good, Andy Kirk.
Yeah, Andy Kirk, yeah, Mary Lou Williams.

items.title: Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: Yeah, and then we had a battle with I think it was Andy Kirk one night at the Golden Gate Ballroom.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. You probably play better than you ever played when you ever run across a band. You remember that battle we had at Washington, D.C. against Gene Krupa?
Yeah, and then we had a battle with I think it was Andy Kirk one night at the Golden Gate Ballroom.
